_comment: Per-provider output form for slash commands. Source commands live at commands/<name>.md (no prefix). The renderer uses this map to decide where to write each command and what name it will be exposed as.
_ux_target: `/devteam:<name>` is the canonical user-facing invocation string. Providers that prohibit `:` in command names use the closest legal alternative and are documented in docs/providers.md.

claude._comment: Claude Code derives the slash name from the subdirectory: .claude/commands/devteam/<name>.md -> /devteam:<name>.

opencode._comment: opencode command names accept `:` when declared as a key in the `command` object of opencode.json. Renderer emits each command as an inline JSON entry and merges into the project's opencode.json(c).

codex._comment: Codex uses project-local skills as the official command surface. The canonical identifier stays `devteam-<name>`, invoked as `$devteam-<name>`.
codex.ux_divergence: Codex does not preserve the `/devteam:<name>` slash namespace; the harness standardizes on project-local skills instead.

frontmatter_to_inline._comment: Codex command skills use SKILL.md frontmatter and delegate into provider-native tools from the command body.
